topic: Lauritzen windowed Variance Shadow Map (VSM) vs raw Chebyshev overlapping blocker light-bleeding rig
topic_zh: Lauritzen 窗口化方差阴影贴图（VSM）对比原始切比雪夫上界重叠遮挡物漏光
scope: Deterministic Donnelly & Lauritzen (2006/2007) pre-filtered 2-moment Variance Shadow Mapping (VSM) with smoothstep light-bleeding windowing versus raw Chebyshev upper bounds and un-prefiltered 32-tap per-pixel blocker summation across 17 umbra receiver depths (z_R in [6.50, 14.50] m). No neural shadow denoising execution.

timing_note: Median of 7 alternating Node CPU runs after warmup. O(1) pre-filtered 2-moment (M1, M2) VSM evaluation versus 32-tap per-pixel blocker moment summation.

protocol.function: p_max = σ² / (σ² + (z_R − μ)²), V = smoothstep(p_min, 1.0, p_max) → Umbra Bleed ≡ 0.00%

robustness.name: Sampled 17 umbra receiver stations behind overlapping blockers maintain 0.00% light bleeding under windowed VSM

good_fit: Pre-filtered soft shadow maps using hardware trilinear mipmaps, anisotropic filtering, and separable Gaussian blurs
Explaining why overlapping blockers (z_A=2.0m, z_B=6.0m) inflate variance σ²=4.0m² and cause raw Chebyshev to leak 20.00%–39.02% light in umbra
Suppressing non-physical Chebyshev probability tails via Lauritzen smoothstep(p_min, 1.0, p_max) windowing
Replacing expensive 32-tap per-pixel PCF shadow loops with O(1) 2-channel (z, z²) moment lookups
not_for: Ray-traced hard pinhole shadows with zero penumbra filter radius
High-depth-complexity foliage stacks (> 4 overlapping layers) requiring 4-moment Moment Shadow Mapping (MSM) or Exponential VSM (EVSM)
Neural spatio-temporal ray-traced shadow denoisers (SVGF / ReLAX)
Unlit scenes without shadow-casting directional or spot lights
